concerns.text: FR-001 (Dataset Fetching/Streaming) and FR-005 (Statistical Fallbacks) lack executable tasks. T006a-d and T008a-e are marked 'rejected' or 'missing' in the analyze report, yet T016 (US1) and T026 (US2) depend on them. No task exists to implement the 'streaming=True' logic or the 'LMM -> Normality -> Stratified' fallback chain described in the spec.

FR-002 (Rule Engine) is partially covered by T015a/b, but T015b (Anomaly Handling) is marked 'missing' in the analyze report. Without T015b, the spec's requirement to 'default to deny' on malformed deletion logs is unimplemented.

Plan element 'quickstart.md' (Phase 1 output) is referenced in T037a, but T037a is marked 'rejected' in the analyze report. No valid task exists to generate the initial project setup instructions and dataset download guide required by the plan.

FR-007 (Failure Case Sampling) requires stratified sampling if N > 50. T029 implements this logic, but T029 depends on T016 and T023/T024, which are blocked by the missing foundational tasks (T006/T008). No independent task exists to implement the sampling logic if the pipeline were functional.

T014a references 'distilbert-base-uncased' but the spec (FR-002) and plan imply a specific intent classifier. While the model ID is present, the task description lacks a clear tag or explicit link to the 'CPU-tractable' constraint in the spec, creating ambiguity on whether the constraint is enforced in the task definition.
